artworks.title: Plate 18: Heron and Stork
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two large birds. One bird on the left has blue-gray plumage, while the other on the right has lighter gray body and black flight feathers. Both birds have long legs and distinctive beaks. The color palette includes soft grays, blues, and earthy greens, with red feet on the birds and brown and green foliage below them. The birds are standing on grassy land within an oval frame, with one bird on the left and the other on the right, surrounded by sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Plate 1: Two Ostriches and a Starling
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ostrich and another bird with an inscription. The painting depicts a large ostrich in the center, with intricate feather detailing and slender legs. Another bird, possibly a starling, stands atop a mound. The terrain features soft hills and sandy ground. An inscription in Latin frames the image. This is in the style of early scientific illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 19: Two Great Egrets with Green Breeding Masks
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two herons surrounded by flora at the edge of a pond. The painting features two herons standing on a bank with detailed plant life around them. One heron stands tall while the other is bent toward the water. The artwork showcases fine detail in the feathers and plants, including various flowers. The scene is framed in an oval with a neutral background. This painting is reminiscent of traditional natural history illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 20: A Plover with Four Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various birds in a natural setting. The work depicts a collection of birds within a circular vignette. There are five birds in total, including two larger terrestrial birds at the bottom with elongated necks and legs, and three smaller birds perched on a twisted branch that intertwines around them. The background shows dry foliage and a small body of water. The style hints at a classical natural history illustration, typical of works that combine scientific observation with artistic representation. The Latin text "PRVDENTIS IMITARE CHARADRIUM" is inscribed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Plate 21: Swamp Hen and Woodcock with a Streaked Rosefinch, a Finch, and Oak Galls
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a blue-and-red bird standing on the ground with a smaller brown bird beside it. Above them are two smaller birds perched on a branch. The color palette includes vibrant blues and reds on the largest bird, with earthy browns on the other two main birds, along with gentle green and cream tones in the background foliage and branch. In the foreground, the blue bird is standing on grass with the brown bird to its right, while in the background, the branch curves overhead diagonally from the left, hosting the two perched birds.

artworks.title: Plate 22: Two White Pelicans with a Sycamore Fig
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two pelicans near water. The painting shows a large white pelican standing on a small mound of yellow sand surrounded by water, with another pelican in the background resting with its head tucked under its wing while floating on the water. A branch with green leaves and round fruit or growths is depicted to the right of the birds. The background is plain. The painting is enclosed within a circular border, with the roman numeral "XXII" on the right side. The style of the painting is similar to that of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Plate 23: A Brandt's Cormorant with a Juvenile Crowned Night Heron
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cormorant and a night heron perched on a gnarled tree branch. The painting showcases both birds, with the cormorant in the foreground resting on the water and the night heron perched on the barren branch of a detailed tree. The colors of the birds, especially the blues and blacks of the cormorant, contrast with the earthy tones and textures of the tree. The illustration is surrounded by an oval frame, and Latin text is inscribed at the top. The style resembles natural history illustrations, similar to works by John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Plate 24: Two Swans, a Kingfisher, and a Bullfinch
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring two swans near a water body. One swan is swimming in the water, while the other is standing at the edge of the water. A colorful bird is perched on a rock, and another bird is on a branch of a nearby tree. The tree has green leaves and hanging vine-like growths with red berries. There is tranquil water in the background, and Latin text is at the top of the image, with a visible Roman numeral 'XXIV'. The style is reminiscent of illuminated manuscript illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 25: Great Spotted Woodpecker, Bullfinches, Sparrows, and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various birds perched on branches. The painting depicts an array of birds resting on intricately detailed branches of a tree. Each bird is distinct in color and size. The branches are detailed with leaves, extending off the frame of the oval illustration. The birds are carefully illustrated, showcasing the unique patterns and colors of their feathers. Above the composition, there is a Latin inscription, with numbers marked near each bird. The perimeter is encompassed by an oval frame, embodying a detailed and observational style reminiscent of traditional ornithological studies.

artworks.title: Plate 26: Cormorant and Coot
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is an image of two birds on a shoreline with a sea view. The painting features two birds with detailed plumage standing on a rocky outcrop by the sea. The left bird has wings partially extended, while the right bird stands upright with a more compact form. Above them is a partially visible branch of a tree with leaves. An oval border encloses the scene, with the Latin inscription "FVLlCA IN PALVDIBVS" above and "XXVI" to the right. The color palette includes earthy tones for the birds and muted blue for the sea. The style is reminiscent of natural history illustrations from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Plate 27: A Common Scoter, a Eurasian Coot, and a Rosefinch(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays two large birds in the foreground: one black bird on the left and another deep blue bird with a white marking on its head on the right. Earthy tones with touches of green, pink, and blue compose the color palette. In the background, there is a tree branch extending into the scene with a small bird perched on it to the upper left, accompanied by an apple and green leaves. On the right, purple flowers and green grasses are positioned near the second bird. Water is visible in the lower part of the scene, surrounding the small patch of land where both birds are placed.

artworks.title: Plate 28: Barnacle Goose with Shrikes and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various birds and botanical elements arranged in a circular composition. The painting features a central large bird standing next to a partially cut tree trunk with visible surface textures, with smaller birds perched on branches. The background suggests a pale green landscape or water surface. Each element is depicted with fine details and soft, naturalistic colors, reminiscent of early botanical and ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 2: Two Eagles
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two eagles in a classical style. The painting features two differently posed eagles within an oval framework. One eagle is perched on the ground, highlighted by its detailed plumage and sharp eyes, while the second eagle is captured in mid-flight with wings fully spread. The words "AQUILA IN NVBIBVS" are inscribed above the eagles, while "AQUILA NON CAPTAT MVSCAS" is below. There is a stone block on the ground with Latin text inscribed. The scene is painted in a realistic style, with attention to detail seen in the feather texturing and the grounded setting of small rocks and soft grass tufts.

artworks.title: Plate 29: Geese with Poppies and a Cyclamen
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting depicts three ducks in a natural setting. The scene includes three ducks with different plumage against a backdrop of flowers and foliage. Two ducks are on land and one is partially submerged in water. Surrounding plants include blooming red poppies and delicate green stems. The artwork is detailed, focusing on the textures of feathers and botanical elements. This style is reminiscent of a naturalist approach from the 16th or 17th century.

artworks.title: Plate 30: A Muscovy(?) Duck, a Four-Legged Duck, and Two Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts four birds - three in water to the right and one on land to the left. The color palette includes muted earth tones such as brown, grey, blue, and green, with hints of orange and red. The single bird stands on the shore with greenery behind it, while the three birds swim in the water. Two branches with round fruits frame the scene at the top.

artworks.title: Plate 31: Duck, Merganser, and Three Goldfinches
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various species of birds in a natural landscape. Two ducks are shown by a body of water in a grassy area. Above them, three smaller birds are perched on a branch with a pear. The image is framed in an oval shape, set against a plain background. Botanical illustrations of plants are on the left side of the frame. Latin text is inscribed at the top, and a Roman numeral "XXXI" is marked in the lower right corner. The style is reminiscent of Audubon.

artworks.title: Plate 32: A Green-Winged Teal, a Juvenile Green Woodpecker, and Two Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features four birds within an oval frame. Two ducks are on the ground near water, while two smaller birds are perched on branches above them. The color palette includes earthy tones, greens, reds, blues, and hints of gold. The ducks are positioned apart, with one on the left and the other on the right. Above them, a branch extends supporting the smaller birds, one with a long red tongue to the left and another with orange-toned feathers to the right. The background within the oval is clear.

artworks.title: Plate 33: A Pair of Bohemian Waxwings, a Shelduck(?), and a Brant Goose with a Ginger Plant
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: There are two ducks on the ground, one with dark plumage and the other with a mix of green, brown, and grey colors on its feathers. Above them on a curved tree branch, there are two smaller birds, one resting and the other standing. The color palette is a blend of natural tones – earthy browns and greens dominate, accompanied by hints of black, grey, and subtle blues and purple on the ducks' feet. The ducks are centrally located, with the dark duck on the left and the multicolored duck on the right. The tree branch stretches above them from left to right, with the two smaller birds situated near the center and right of the branch.

artworks.title: Plate 34: Bird of Paradise with Mereganser(?) and Grebe(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds within a circular frame. The first bird has a long, flowing tail of iridescent hues. The second bird has dark plumage with a lighter underbelly and is swimming. The third bird is small with warm tones, resting on the water. Each bird is labeled with a number. Script in a decorative font encircles the top of the illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 35: Female Green-Winged Teal, Red-Breasted Merganser(?), Sparrow, and a Greenfinch(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nature scene featuring birds and ducks near a body of water. The scene is set within an oval frame, depicting two ducks in the lower portion - one is on land, while the other is on the water. Above them, perched on a branch of a fruit-bearing tree with lush green leaves, are two smaller birds. The branch is positioned diagonally across the frame. Additionally, sentences of text are inscribed both above and below the image while Roman numerals mark it as part of a series.

artworks.title: Plate 36: Red-Breasted Merganser, Shoveler, and Mallard, and Duck with Artichokes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of four birds standing in and around water, with a decorative element above. The image shows a group of four birds positioned on the edge of a water body. One bird is completely in the water, while the others are either in shallow water or on the shore. Above the scene, there is an ornamental feature consisting of paisley-like patterned leaves and ribbons. The image is framed within an oval border, with the number "XXVI" written on the right edge within the frame. This is in the style of an ornithological illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 37: Three Waterfowl with Two Nightingales(?)  Perched in Citrus Trees
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is an image of birds and fruit. It shows three ducks or similar waterfowl on a grassy and watery ground in the lower part of the composition, and two smaller birds perched on branches of a lemon tree in the upper section. Lemons, some ripe and others still growing, hang above the birds. The painting is reminiscent of works by early botanists or ornithologists who documented wildlife. It is marked with Latin inscriptions and a Roman numeral on the right.

artworks.title: Plate 38: Merganser with Two Other Waterfowl and a Garland of Melons and Gourds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds in a natural setting with decorative elements. Above the scene of a lake, there are three birds, one flying over the water and two swimming. The sky is clear with no clouds, the vegetation is sparse, and the water is mostly calm. The scene is framed within an oval, with a decorative element above consisting of squash, foliage, and ribbon. On the right side of the image, the Roman numeral XXXVIII is inscribed.

artworks.title: Plate 3: Two Hawks
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two large brown birds are depicted next to each other on a grassy ground within an oval frame. The birds are shaded in different hues of brown with yellow accents on their talons. They stand near a large green fern leaf and several smaller plants. The background is colored in shades of pale cream and green. The birds are facing to the right in profile, with one slightly ahead of the other, both positioned near the center of the image.
